//go:build e2e

// Stage 4a's previous-layout fixture. scripts/e2e/stage4a-sandbox-runtime.sh copies this file into
// a checkout of the commit LEGION_E2E_PREVIOUS_IMAGE was built from (a commit of main at daemon API
// contract 37, the pod-owned disk, or 38, the blocked issues, whose issue pods still run six role containers), as
// zz_previous_layout_fixture_test.go of its internal/runtime/sandbox, and builds that package's
// Stage 4a harness with it. The previous-layout check of this branch's harness runs the result once,
// while its own runtime is stopped: the previous release's own runtime and rig launch the issue
// S4A-10's architect and tester in one pod of that layout, on the previous release's worker image,
// exactly as a deployment running it would, and leave both running. Each claim's marker is at the
// root of that pod's own disk, which every role container of the layout mounts and which dies with
// the pod, and its session is recorded in the run's session table (awaitRunning's recordSession),
// where every pod of either release reads it. It writes each claim's launch, its boot token and
// session among it, to LEGION_E2E_PREVIOUS_LAYOUT_OUT (owner-only) as one JSON array, as the
// daemon's store would hold it across the upgrade; this branch's harness reads and removes the
// file, and its runtime takes the claims over. Nothing else of the previous harness runs.

package sandbox

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/sjawhar/legion/daemon/internal/claim"
	"github.com/sjawhar/legion/daemon/internal/runtime"
)

// previousLaunch is one claim the fixture launched: what the taking-over harness needs to hold it
// as its own, the way a daemon's store would after the upgrade.
type previousLaunch struct {
	Name    string          `json:"name"`
	Tree    string          `json:"tree"`
	Issue   string          `json:"issue"`
	Role    claim.Role      `json:"role"`
	Token   claim.Token     `json:"token"`
	Gen     uint64          `json:"generation"`
	Boot    string          `json:"bootToken"`
	Marker  string          `json:"marker"`
	Session string          `json:"session"`
	Locator runtime.Locator `json:"locator"`
	Pod     string          `json:"pod"`
	Names   []string        `json:"containers"`
}

func TestStage4aPreviousLayoutFixture(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("LEGION_E2E_PREVIOUS_LAYOUT_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Fatal("LEGION_E2E_PREVIOUS_LAYOUT_OUT is unset")
	}
	env := readLiveEnv(t)
	r := newLiveRig(t, env)
	defer r.close()
	r.mapRepository(r.env.repo)
	var launched []previousLaunch
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name string
		role claim.Role
	}{{"prev-architect", claim.RoleArchitect}, {"prev-tester", claim.RoleTester}} {
		token, err := claim.NewToken(env.claimProject, "S4A-10", c.role)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		lc := &liveClaim{token: token, tree: "S4A-10", issue: "S4A-10", role: c.role, name: c.name,
			marker:  TreeRoot + "/" + SandboxName(token) + ".marker",
			session: ompSessionsDir + "/" + SandboxName(token) + "-" + string(c.role) + ".jsonl"}
		r.claims = append(r.claims, lc)
		since := time.Now()
		if _, err := r.spawn(lc, true); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Spawn(%s) on the previous release: %v", c.name, err)
		}
		if _, err := r.awaitRunning(lc, since); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s running on the previous release: %v", c.name, err)
		}
		pod, err := r.getPod(SandboxName(token))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		names := make([]string, 0, len(pod.Spec.Containers))
		for _, container := range pod.Spec.Containers {
			names = append(names, container.Name)
		}
		launched = append(launched, previousLaunch{
			Name: c.name, Tree: lc.tree, Issue: lc.issue, Role: c.role, Token: token, Gen: lc.gen, Boot: lc.bootToken,
			Marker: lc.marker, Session: lc.session, Locator: *lc.loc, Pod: string(pod.UID), Names: names,
		})
		fmt.Printf("   [previous] %s running at generation %d in pod %s (uid %s), containers %v\n", c.name, lc.gen, pod.Name, pod.UID, names)
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(launched)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, raw, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
